*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  R_ASSIGN_HEADER_FIELD_TO_FIELD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       RPY_DYNPRO_READ:                                               *
*       Attribute des internen Dynpro-Headers dem Dynpro-Header in
*       externer Darstellung zuordnen
*       Attributzuordnungen Feld -> Feld
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_HEADER_INT   Header (intern)                               *
*      <--P_DYNP_HEADER  Header (extern)                               *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM R_ASSIGN_HEADER_FIELD_TO_FIELD
               USING    VALUE(P_HEADER_INT)  TYPE DYNPRO_HEADER
               CHANGING P_DYNP_HEADER        TYPE RPYTY_DYNP_HEADER.

   P_DYNP_HEADER-PROGRAM   = P_HEADER_INT-PROG.     "Programmname
   P_DYNP_HEADER-SCREEN    = P_HEADER_INT-DNUM.     "Dynpronummer
   IF P_HEADER_INT-TYPE = ' '.                      "Dynprotyp
     P_DYNP_HEADER-TYPE = 'N'.
   ELSE.
     P_DYNP_HEADER-TYPE = P_HEADER_INT-TYPE.
   ENDIF.
   P_DYNP_HEADER-NEXTSCREEN = P_HEADER_INT-FNUM.    "Folgedynpronummer
   P_DYNP_HEADER-SCREEN_GRP = P_HEADER_INT-DGRP.    "Bildgruppe
   P_DYNP_HEADER-LINES      = P_HEADER_INT-NOLI.    "Zeilen zur Pflege
   P_DYNP_HEADER-COLUMNS    = P_HEADER_INT-NOCO.    "Spalten zur Pflege
   P_DYNP_HEADER-LANGUAGE   = P_HEADER_INT-SPRA.    "Mastersprache
   P_DYNP_HEADER-CURSOR_POS = P_HEADER_INT-CUPO.    "Cursorpositionierg.
   IF NOT ( P_HEADER_INT-HDAT IS INITIAL ).         "Halten Daten
     P_DYNP_HEADER-HOLD_DATA  = 'X'.
   ELSE.
     P_DYNP_HEADER-HOLD_DATA  = ' '.
   ENDIF.
   IF  P_HEADER_INT-CUAN = 'F'.                     "Äquidistanzschrift
     P_DYNP_HEADER-FIXED_FONT = 'X'.
   ELSE.
     P_DYNP_HEADER-FIXED_FONT = ' '.
   ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " R_ASSIGN_HEADER_FIELD_TO_FIELD
